name: Pixian Doubanjiang (Chili Bean Paste)
where: Large supermarkets or official stores that carry the Juancheng brand
about: This fermented chili bean paste comes from Pixian County, just outside Chengdu. It is the base of many Sichuan dishes, especially mapo tofu.
tip: Check the sealed packaging and the aging period printed on the label before you buy.

name: Shu Brocade Silk Pouch
where: Gift shop at the Chengdu Shu Brocade Museum
about: Shu brocade is a traditional silk weaving craft that has been practiced in Chengdu for centuries. Small pouches show the city's old textile skills in a portable form.
tip: Look at the fabric and how the pattern is made, and ask whether the piece is hand-woven or machine-made.

name: Sichuan Huajiao (Sichuan Peppercorn)
where: Hongqi Chain or the spice section of large supermarkets
about: Sichuan peppercorns give the numbing sensation found in many local dishes. Chengdu cooking relies on them heavily.
tip: Smell both red and green varieties before choosing, since their flavors differ.
